messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: KV cache hit-rate for `kv-cache/main` in us-east-1 dropped to 21% (alert threshold: <50%). SLO risk: increased p99 latency for short-context generations. Pager: Maya. Please acknowledge and start mitigation.
Maya (oncall): ack — I'm on it. seeing elevated eviction_rate too. pulling grafana now.
Ravi: on laptop, will join. Maya, can you confirm whether this is single region?
Maya (oncall): looks isolated to us-east-1 workers. other regions show normal ~78% hit.
Jules: are we seeing correlated CPU/GPU throttling or a deployment at ~05:20 UTC?
Ken: no infra deploys in us-east-1 since yesterday. network metrics look fine.
Maya (oncall): stacktrace / logs show a sudden increase in unique prompt prefixes causing many cold misses. evict_count spiked.
Priya: rolling back to warm-cache policy might help immediately — can we temporarily increase max_cache_entries for us-east?
Maya (oncall): I can change dynamic config to +25% max_entries for pool-us-east, but want to avoid memory OOM. current usage ~72% of budget.
Ravi: do it. If mem crosses 90% we can rollback.
Maya (oncall): applying config patch now: `rdwctl config set cache.pool-us-east.max_entries 1.25x --reason "incident mitigation"`
eng-alerts-bot: CONFIG PATCH applied by Maya. Monitor for 2m.
Maya (oncall): hit-rate climbed to 44% after config change, latency trending down. still below SLO but improving.
Ken: I'm pushing a conservative eviction-threshold tweak too: prolong TTL for prefetched keys from 30s -> 90s for short-context models.
Jules: also enabling fallback routing: if hit_rate < 40% for 2m, route reads to cold-store with throttled concurrency to avoid end-user errors. I can push a canary policy.
Priya: can we silence noisy alert flapping? the alert fired 6 times in 10m — we should change to 5m sustained window.
Maya (oncall): agreed. I'm going to silence the repeated pager while we mitigate: `/silence incident:kv-cache-hitrate us-east-1 for 20m`
eng-alerts-bot: ALERT SILENCED by Maya for 20m.
Morgan: taking a note for customer impact: we saw 0.6% increase in error rate on hosted API for short-context routes, estimated 140k affected requests in last 15m. Raising to Priority-Customer Slack.
Ravi: thanks. Maya, once we confirm stability, make a runbook note on what worked. We should not rely on config bumps as a long-term fix.
Maya (oncall): current plan: 1) temporary config bump (done) 2) TTL tweak (done) 3) enable controlled fallback (in progress) 4) post-incident follow-ups: alert tuning + dashboard + capacity plan.
Jules: adding immediate dashboard card request: per-tenant KV hit_rate, eviction_rate, and memory_utilization for last 24h with 1m granularity. I'll file a Grafana panel PR.
Priya: propose alert rule change: only fire pager if hit_rate < 40% AND eviction_rate > 1000/s for 5m OR hit_rate < 25% for 3m. Less noise, catches real capacity issues.
eng-alerts-bot: NOTE: Suggested alert rule saved as draft by Priya.
Maya (oncall): handoff to Ravi in 20m for overnight. Ravi, I'll leave the incident page with current mitigations and immediate actions.
Ravi: ack. I'll watch for mem and evictions. If hit_rate stays >60% for 10m and mem <80% we can close.
Maya (oncall): after-action items being created: (TASK-1127) create per-tenant hit-rate dashboard, (TASK-1128) implement new eviction alert, (TASK-1129) run eviction-safety analysis and capacity projection for us-east.
Ken: I'll prep a short capacity buffer proposal for Dedicated customers to reduce noisy cache churn.
Morgan: customer comms: drafting a short note for affected tenants. estimated rc: partial impact, degraded latency for short prompts only.
Ravi: closing loop — hit_rate steady ~66% and p99 latency stabilized. I'll mark incident as recovering and will schedule a postmortem tomorrow with Maya/Jules/Priya/Ken.
Maya (oncall): thanks team. quick reminder for post-incident remediation: 1) formalize the new Prometheus alert (Priya) 2) dashboard PR (Jules) 3) add a synthetic that exercises hot-prefixes to detect this earlier (Eng-DevEx) 4) consider auto-prefetch heuristics to avoid cold bursts.
eng-alerts-bot: INCIDENT RECOVERY logged by Ravi. Incident severity: Sev3 -> Resolved (mitigations applied). Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC.
Maya (oncall): handing off to Ravi now. logging final notes in incident tracker. thanks all :heart:
